title.en: SAMPLE: A robot lab reports a magnetic material that keeps its strength
title.zh: SAMPLE：機器人實驗室報告保有磁力的磁性材料

found.en: A robot lab run by an AI planner reported a new magnetic material that keeps its strength up to 400 degrees.
found.zh: 一間由 AI 規劃系統運作的機器人實驗室，報告了一種新的磁性材料，溫度高達 400 度時仍保有磁力。

matters.en: Strong magnets that work in the heat could help motors and generators, so a new material with that property would be useful.
matters.zh: 能在高溫下運作的強力磁鐵，可能有助於馬達和發電機，所以具有這種特性的新材料會很有用。

ai_helped.en: Hartwell Materials Lab built the Cobalt Planner, which chose each sample to make next. Robots made and tested the samples.
ai_helped.zh: Hartwell Materials Lab 開發了 Cobalt Planner，由它挑選下一個要製作的樣本。機器人製作並測試這些樣本。

how_sure.en: Checked. Sample Physics Letters published the paper after peer review. Hartwell Materials Lab, the maker of the planner, wrote the paper.
how_sure.zh: 已查核。Sample Physics Letters 在同儕審查後發表了這篇論文。規劃系統的開發者 Hartwell Materials Lab 撰寫了這篇論文。

background.en: A magnet loses strength as it gets hot, and each material has its own limit.
background.zh: 磁鐵變熱時磁力會減弱，每種材料都有各自的極限。

could_lead.en: If other labs repeat the result, the material could be tried in real machines.
could_lead.zh: 如果其他實驗室重現這項結果，這種材料可能會在實際的機器上試用。

evidence.quote: The Cobalt Planner, built by Hartwell Materials Lab, chose each sample to make next

note.en: Retracted by Sample Physics Letters on 8 Oct 2026.
note.zh: Sample Physics Letters 於 2026 年 10 月 8 日撤稿。
